name: Martin Wagner
headline: Partner Account Management @ EGYM Wellpass
summary: With more than 10 years of expertise in B2B and B2C sales, I am a dedicated professional in account and partner management, as well as business development. My diverse background encompasses consulting, dynamic start-ups, and high-velocity industries. I have built strong collaborations with key clients and partners across industries including fitness, software and IT, e-commerce, mobility, consumer goods, and healthcare. Fueled by a hands-on mindset and an unwavering commitment to personal growth, I am passionate about inspiring and elevating those I work with.

positions.title: Senior Partner Account Manager
positions.description:
EGYM Wellpass is a corporate fitness network that connects companies with over 13,500 sports and wellness facilities throughout Germany and Austria. Employees gain access to gyms, swimming pools, wellness services, online fitness classes, and mental health offerings through a digital platform. The goal is to make holistic corporate health management simple and flexible.

In my role as a Senior Partner Account Manager, I am responsible for maintaining and growing relationships with existing partners, including key accounts such as large fitness chains as well as small and medium-sized partners. This includes support with contractual, strategic, and operational matters. Further, I define tactical goals in collaboration with partners and monitor relevant KPIs to ensure goal achievement. This also involves planning and conducting regular alignment meetings and business reviews by generating reports on partner performance, analysing user data and optimising Wellpass offers. In addition, I contribute innovative ideas to improve our strategic partner management and actively participate in cross-functional projects to optimize collaboration and processes.

positions.title: Senior Partner Manager
positions.description:
Personio is the holistic HR software and people operating system for small and medium-sized companies with up to 2,000 employees. The software provider based in Munich, Berlin, Madrid, Barcelona, London, Dublin and Amsterdam has set itself the goal of making people processes faster, clearer and more efficient. This gives HR managers time again to concentrate on the most valuable asset of successful companies: their employees. For this purpose Personio is developing an all-in-one software solution for recruiting, people management and payroll. More than 11,000 customers in over 80 countries are already using Personio successfully.

As a Senior Partner Manager at Personio, I forged and nurtured relationships with over 90 key partners, empowering them to introduce their clients or prospects to Personio. By leveraging our holistic HR operating system and its software integrations, we helped streamline and digitalize their clients' operations. Together, we continuously refined the Personio partnership program, fostering a rewarding collaboration and ensuring the best experience for both our partners and their clients.

positions.title: Engagement Manager
positions.description:
Netlight Consulting is a Swedish IT company with 9 locations in Northern and Central Europe. The focus is on consulting services in technical implementation and IT management. Based on "self-directed teams" Netlight works without hierarchical intermediate levels (> 1,500 employees). With great success and commitment, Netlight drives the digital revolution and helps pioneers of the digital industry to realize business critical IT projects.

As an Engagement Manager at Netlight Consulting, I pioneered and nurtured deep-rooted, authentic relationships with stakeholders, clients, and our IT consultants, focusing on industries like mobility, e-commerce, and proptech. My multifaceted role combined sales, account management, and project management. I served as the pivotal point for organization and communication throughout the entire project lifecycle. My responsibilities ranged from preparing and negotiating contracts and tenders to managing and expanding existing client relationships and discerning potential new client opportunities.

positions.title: Sales & Key Account Manager
positions.description:
Testbirds is specialised in testing software such as apps, websites or Internet of Things applications using innovative technologies and solutions. The IT service provider uses cloud-based technologies to help customers optimise their digital products. Testbirds was founded in 2011 and had over 100 employees with offices in Munich, Amsterdam and London.

As a Sales & Key Account Manager, I acquired and managed key clients in areas like consumer goods, e-commerce, health care and chemistry. Moreover, next to analysing existing customer’s potential, I further developed sales strategies and concepts to optimise and continuously improve Testbirds’ sales processes. The coordination of onboarding new sales colleagues was one of my additional responsibilities.

positions.title: Regional Manager Stores
positions.description:
mymuesli GmbH is a German company based in Passau, which sells individual muesli mixes as well as classic pre-packaged muesli over the Internet, in its own stores and through food retailing partners.

As a Regional Manager Stores, I directly reported to the Director of Stores and implemented the company’s sales strategy throughout the region of South-East of Germany and Austria. This role contained the leadership and further development of thirteen (13) stores and mymuesli’s unique store concept. I supervised store managers and sales personnel in my dedicated area, led 1-to-1’s, career development conversations and interviews with applicants.

positions.title: In my role as a Store Manager, I supervised two mymuesli stores in Passau and Linz. Together with the Director of Stores, I planned and realized the stores’ annual sales targets, organized and defined our employee planning, led and trained sales personnel.
positions.description: As a Buying Department Assistant, I directly reported to Co-Founder and Managing Director Philipp Kraiss. My role included the acquisition of potential new vendors and comparison with existing ones, identify potential cost savings, the clustering of vendors based on predefined criteria and further individual research.

positions.title: Sports Marketing Intern
positions.description:
Bauerfeind AG is a German manufacturer of medical aids such as bandages, orthoses, compression stockings and orthopedic insoles.

During my internship at Bauerfeind in their sports marketing department, I implemented sales supporting activities and initiated the collaboration with external service providers like medical supply stores. Additionally, I was able to optimize and structure Bauerfeind’s athletes’ supply while fastened their processes.

Egal ob Fitness, Schwimmen, Yoga, Klettern oder vieles mehr - hier findet jeder sein persönliches Programm! 

Und das Beste: Arbeitnehmer zahlen nur einen geringen Beitrag, da sich die Arbeitgeber an den Kosten beteiligen und in die Gesundheit der Mitarbeitenden investieren.
